ordering: Editorial curriculum, easiest to frontier; not a measured model ranking or equal-interval scale. Status changes do not reorder tasks.

bands.title: Foundations
bands.description: Load, halt, and copy fixed amounts of input. Canonical programs and early tool baselines establish the floor.

bands.title: Input-dependent construction
bands.description: Route inputs, realize small maps, and fit public lookup tables. Placement across these tasks is an editorial estimate.

bands.title: Coverage to full XOR
bands.description: Increase byte coverage, then reach all 256 first-byte values. Several milestones share a winning program.

bands.title: Compact arithmetic
bands.description: Compress full XOR and solve a neighboring 256-byte rotation task. The XOR size ordering follows from nested limits.

bands.title: Multiple-byte transforms
bands.description: Transform several bytes within tight limits. Cross-task placement is provisional; first-byte sweeps do not enumerate all byte tuples.

bands.title: Variable-length programs
bands.description: Handle streams with an unknown endpoint: copy, count, accumulate, then reverse. These frontier placements await successful constructions.

rungs.title: Echo until EOF
rungs.summary: Copy the entire input and halt when it ends.
rungs.rationale: Provisional capability order: copying, counting, accumulation, and storage. The fixed public 81-case suite is evidence of behavior on those cases; it does not prove a loop or arbitrary-length correctness.

rungs.title: Count the input bytes
rungs.summary: Emit the input length as one byte, then halt.
rungs.rationale: Provisional capability order: copying, counting, accumulation, and storage. The fixed public 81-case suite is evidence of behavior on those cases; it does not prove a loop or arbitrary-length correctness.

rungs.title: Sum the input bytes

rungs.rationale: Provisional capability order: copying, counting, accumulation, and storage. The fixed public 81-case suite is evidence of behavior on those cases; it does not prove a loop or arbitrary-length correctness.

rungs.title: Reverse the entire input
